name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Soothing Lullaby
attacks.text: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins for this Special Condition, and if any of them are tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

flavor:
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously
soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
